title: Kula Today
heading: Yesterday · Wed 11 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast moderate). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 09:00 to about 17:00. A high day for November: the base reached about 5,600 ft (normal 4,500–5,500 ft). The evening before, the page called it normal, about 5,200 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 5,600 ft by the Kekoa camera, 400 ft higher than the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,100 ft, off by 500 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,900 ft, off by 700 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 16:52, crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); the Mesonet could not be reached on 10 of 57 updates.
